api.badResponse: Couldn't understand the PC's response. Update the app to the latest version.
api.connectFailed: Couldn't connect to the PC. Try again in a moment.
api.pairFailed: Couldn't connect. Check the code and try again.
api.logoutFailed: Couldn't disconnect. Disconnect it in Settings on the PC.

app.title: eud-agent remote access
app.help: Click Connect Phone in the PC header and scan the QR code to connect right away. To enter the code manually, type the 8-character code shown on the PC.

chat.teamCandidateReady: Map Agent created candidate r{{revision}}. The AI will review it next. You can also apply or discard it yourself in the Map window on the PC.
chat.teamApplied: The map candidate was applied. You can continue.
chat.isolatedStart: Starting changes in the isolated workspace.
chat.nothingToCompact: There's no conversation to compact. Send a message first.
chat.modelFallback: Couldn't apply the chosen model, so starting with the default model.
chat.planRevisionFailed: Couldn't process the plan revision request.
chat.steerFailed: Couldn't deliver the message to the AI at work: {{error}}
chat.planReviewDesc: Approve to start work on this plan. To suggest changes, type them in the message box and send.

apply.title: Apply the candidate to the source map?
apply.desc: The saved source map is replaced by the candidate. A backup is kept before applying, and you can undo the apply on the PC or on this screen. Applying is refused while the map is open in SCMDraft or similar.

undo.title: Undo the last apply?
undo.desc: Restores the source map from the backup made just before the last apply.

discard.title: Discard the candidate?
discard.desc: Throws away all candidate revisions of this conversation. The source map doesn't change.

revert.title: Go back to an earlier revision?
revert.desc: Reverts the candidate to r{{revision}}. Later revisions are lost.

map.noDiff: Nothing differs from the source map.
map.locked: The candidate can't be changed while a request is running.
map.title: Map work
map.resetDone: Conversation reset. The next request starts a new model session.
map.rewindFailed: Couldn't rewind the conversation to the edited message: {{error}}
map.applied: Applied the candidate to the source map.
map.subtitle: {{project}} · Map Agent
map.emptyTitle: What should we build on the map?
map.emptyDesc: Describe what to create or change and I'll make a candidate map. You can select areas in the Map window on the PC.
map.placeholder: e.g. Build jungle terrain around the start location that fits two P5 bunkers
map.resetDialogDesc: The model conversation starts over. The map candidate, revisions and the conversation log on screen stay as they are.

model.outside_one: {{count}} tile changed outside the target area
model.outside_other: {{count}} tiles changed outside the target area
model.protected_one: {{count}} tile changed in the protected area
model.protected_other: {{count}} tiles changed in the protected area
model.diverged: The saved source map changed and the candidate couldn't be realigned. Applying overwrites the saved map with the candidate (a backup is kept).
model.stale: The source map changed. When the running request finishes, the candidate will follow the new source.

workspace.closed: Lost connection to the PC. Reconnecting…
workspace.noProjects: There are no open or recent projects. Open a project on the PC once, then tap Refresh.
workspace.closeForceDesc: {{refusal}} If you stop the work and close, conversations and plans awaiting review are kept when you reopen it.
workspace.closeDesc: {{name}} will also close on the PC. Conversations are kept.
workspace.mapSub: Map Agent work and team work handed off by EPS conversations
workspace.noMap: There's no map work yet. Start new map work.
workspace.noConv: There are no conversations yet. Start a new conversation.
workspace.renameDesc: Enter the name to show in the list.
workspace.deleteDesc: {{name}} will also be deleted on the PC. This can't be undone.
workspace.projectLost: The project connection was lost. Select it again.
